items.title: Fred Wesley interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 21, 2024
items.q: You know I think George kind of learned a lot from him.

ctx.x: I didn’t know too much about Sun Ra. But my drummer played with him and we talk about him often you know. And he was an attention mongrel. He wanted attention so he created this, from the sky, much like George Clinton. You know I think George kind of learned a lot from him.

It’s funny you say that because the reason I brought it up, I was looking at some “Parliament Funkadelic” video this morning and it made me think of Sun Ra. Like these guys had the same kind of outrageous, look-at-me type approach.
